[[File:OperationShadowstrikeMap.png|thumb|right|220px|A map of NCW-781 depicting Target Yavin]]
'''Target Yavin''', also referred to as '''Target "Yavin,"''' was an area on the<ref name="IA" /> [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[NCW-781 system/Legends|NCW-781 system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[NCW-781]]. It lay to the west of a range of [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] and to the north of an area of [[Forest/Legends|woods]].<ref name="IA" /> The area shared its name with [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]] and the site of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
